newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-NORTHERN IRELAND NAME TEAM FOR ALBANIA MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NORTHERN IRELAND NAME TEAM FOR ALBANIA MATCH.

text.p: Anton Rogan keeps his place in Northern Ireland's World Cup squad for the doubtful group nine qualifier against Albania in Belfast on December 14..
The Millwall defender received an 11th hour call-up last month when Keith Rowland was taken ill and pulled out of the trip to Nuremberg.
The ex-Sunderland and Celtic player then went on against Germany as a second half substitute for Neil Lennon to make sure Bryan Hamilton's battling side held on for a superb 1-1 draw.
The Irish F.A. have been told by FIFA to carry on as normal while negotiations aimed at lifting Albania's ban from the World Cup continue.
World football bosses retaliated last week after the Tirana government suspended the Albanian FA secretary and his executive committee.
Albania's sports minister claimed the FA had flouted civil law by not holding elections for committee places.
But FIFA insisted they would not tolerate political interference and called for the suspended officials to be reinstated.
The Albanians have been given until Saturday to comply, although the IFA are pressing for a decision within the next 48 hours and remain optimistic the match will proceed as planned.
Hamilton said: "It's all up to the administrators. I'm proceeding on the basis that the game will be played.
"I'll be surprised if things are not resolved because there's a lot of money at stake for Albania in World Cup income."
A ruling is expected on Tuesday.

Wright (Reading), Fettis (Nottm Forest), Worthington, McMahon (both Stoke), Rogan (Millwall), Gillespie (Newcastle), Hughes, Dowie, Rowland (West Ham), Lennon, Hill (Leicester), Lomas (Man City), Taggart (Bolton), Hunter (Reading), Gray (Nancy), Horlock (Swindon), Griffin (St Johnstone), Morrow (Arsenal), Nolan (Sheff Wed).
